verdict.rationale: Motion explicitly documents combining Google, Outlook, and iCloud calendars into a single view and automatically reshuffling schedules to avoid conflicts, which directly supports the core story. However, there's no explicit evidence describing conflict-detection logic across all three specific providers simultaneously or confirmation of robustness (e.g., no independent/hands-on verification of double-booking prevention). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of cross-calendar conflict detection, explicit mention of Apple Calendar sync details beyond iCloud, and documentation of edge-case handling (e.g., overlapping events across providers).
